scope: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi
title: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
blurb: The UAE’s grand mosque, completed 2007: an 85 m main dome among 82 white marble domes, four 107 m minarets, and a marble courtyard for 40,000 worshippers.

systems.name: Main dome
systems.description: The 85 m main dome, the largest of its kind, on its drum with golden finial and crescent.

systems.name: Domes
systems.description: The remaining 81 white marble domes in seven sizes across the roofs.

systems.name: Minarets
systems.description: Four minarets of about 104 to 107 m in mixed Mamluk, Ottoman and Fatimid styles.

systems.name: Prayer hall and wings
systems.description: The main prayer hall block and the side wings carrying the smaller domes.

systems.name: Courtyard
systems.description: The 17,000 sq m marble sahan courtyard.

systems.name: Colonnades
systems.description: Arcaded colonnades around the courtyard, over a thousand columns in total.

systems.name: Reflective pools
systems.description: The dark-tiled reflective pools flanking the courtyard.

systems.name: Entrances
systems.description: The main portal and side gates.
